confidence_notes: FX is from one RBA search result, which gave 0.6720 USD per AUD for 2026-11-18. Food and drink anchors come from one search of aggregated cost-of-living sites (Nomad Watch, Traveltables, CityCost, MyLifeElsewhere, WhereAndWhen). Those sources disagree and some are crowdsourced or dated, so the figures are rough. Tourist-resort prices are likely higher than the local averages. I did not find cocktail or wine prices. I set them from the beer price, with a resort and alcohol-licence markup. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. Hostel supply in Sharm is thin, so the hostel figures are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Red Sea resort cities such as Hurghada, and with Egypt-wide prices adjusted upward for tourist-area pricing.
